title: Made this after playing a mouse only game a month ago. "Fruits: The Gathering"
author: tzohnys
selftext:
A month ago (to this day) I went on itch.io in order to pass the time on something casual I could play in browser for a few minutes.

Fast forward now and I have this prototype. It's a small game when you don't have something else to do and just want to smash your left mouse button. Haha

For graphics I used Gemini and GPT image. For sound effects and background music ComfyUI. For coding OpenCode and VSCode.

I hadn't made a new game for roughly 5 years. With all this AI explosion I can sort of get back into it!
